_what: The pre-registered cue-repair plan measured and applied by eval/cue_repair_eval.py. Candidates come from the collateral hand-read (RESULTS-2026-09-07-collateral-eval.md): every cue whose read spans were cue-only or quoted, plus the one defective cue. The RULE decides; nothing here is a verdict. Actions: cut (remove the cue), replace (remove it, add the gold-attested narrower phrasing), exclude (keep it, add match-local `excludes` for the attested false-fire pattern). See PREREG-2026-09-07-cue-repair.md.

rule.cut_iff: no positive fixture breaks; no demonstrated detection is demoted; the cue's own PTC lift interval does not clear 1; no read span carried the construct by EITHER reader; and the cue is benign-ubiquitous (>= ptc_bg_min occurrences in the unannotated PTC background, or >= bg_min_occurrences in the general-prose pool) or marked defective
rule.replace_iff: the cut rule holds for the generic form AND every added cue is in the detection's gold text AND is not itself benign-ubiquitous
rule.exclude_iff: >= exclude_min_read read spans (cue-only or quoted) attest the false-fire pattern; the exclusion silences no span either reader marked construct-present; no fixture breaks; no demonstrated detection is demoted

matcher_rule.name: contraction guard
matcher_rule.text: a bounded match whose end is followed by an apostrophe (' or U+2019) and a letter is rejected unless the tail is an accepted suffix ('s); implemented identically in tradecraft/detect.py (_find_bounded, CONTRACTION_GUARD) and website/static/tech/instrument/engine.js (findBounded); blast radius measured with --boundary on PTC, the background pool, the fixtures and the collateral

candidates.defective: a prefix of the contraction "you haven't"; the gold phrase is already carried by `passed through the degrees`
